censor_definition: positive through k=39 => right-censored at K=40

extension_rule.trigger: pooled censoring fraction > 0.25 OR either batch censoring fraction > 0.25
extension_rule.rule: K=60 is required before a population-level closure-time claim when the trigger is met.

update_magnitude_metrics.pair_local_cumulative: L2 norm restricted to the two forced L1 expert blocks: ||theta_k_pair - theta_0_pair||
update_magnitude_metrics.pair_local_step: L2 norm of one SGD step restricted to the two forced L1 expert blocks: ||theta_{k+1}_pair - theta_k_pair||
update_magnitude_metrics.full_model_cumulative: L2 norm over all model parameters: ||theta_k - theta_0||
update_magnitude_metrics.full_model_step: L2 norm of one SGD step over all model parameters: ||theta_{k+1} - theta_k||
update_magnitude_metrics.logging: Both cumulative and per-step quantities are logged for every pair, batch, and trajectory step.

partial_relationship_models.analysis_family: discrete-time hazard GEE with Binomial family and trajectory-clustered robust covariance
partial_relationship_models.event: DeltaA_finite <= 0 at the first crossing step
partial_relationship_models.Model_C: event ~ contains_7 + pair_delta_theta_cum_pre + time_scaled + time2 + batch2
partial_relationship_models.Model_C_decision: Expert-7 partial support requires beta_contains_7 > 0 AND the two-sided 95% CI excludes zero.

expert7_enrichment.null_statement: Under random unordered pair involvement, P(expert 7 in pair) = 7/28 = 0.25.
expert7_enrichment.test: one-sided exact hypergeometric enrichment test P(X >= observed crossed-with-7 count)
expert7_enrichment.batch_consistency: Both batches must independently show enrichment above 0.25 with p < alpha. Pooled significance cannot rescue a failed batch.

predictor_QA.per_step: Within every batch and k, report first-vs-finite Spearman and sign agreement separately within positive and nonpositive subsets.

K20_archive_supplement.near_crossing: For every K20 observed crossing, record DeltaA_1st and DeltaA_finite at W and W-1.
K20_archive_supplement.interpretation: Relative error is retained, but near-zero crossings must also be evaluated using absolute error.

named_counterexample.rule: Pair (1,4) must remain in all K40 analyses and must not be dropped for expert-7 analysis.

mu_reproducibility_note: The K40 run records its own mu values. The earlier Design B theta3 k=0 estimate differed by ~9.5e-7 from the K20 run. This is within float32 tolerance and consistent with reduction-order differences, but the cause is not isolated and the runs are not bit-identical.
